items.title: An $850,000 Portfolio in Park Hotels & Resorts, Healthpeak and Verizon Pays $51,477 a Year in Dividends. Here’s What Happens if One Cuts
items.summary: Key TakeawaysA $850,000 portfolio split evenly across Park Hotels & Resorts, Healthpeak Properties and Verizon pays about $4,290 a month in dividends at today’s prices. Each dividend is covered on its own measure: 51% of AFFO at Park, 72% of AFFO at Healthpeak, and 52% of free cash flow at Verizon.
